title: Get Free Check-ups, Basic Medicines, and Vaccines — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: The [RHU OCAMPO](https://www.facebook.com/1278129182308012) page exists. Its listed mobile matches the header number.
content:
Get Free Check-ups, Basic Medicines, and Vaccines — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

The Municipal Health Office and barangay health stations are where Ocampo residents ask for check-ups, medicines, and vaccines. Which services are free, and on which day, is not published on this page. Ask the station that covers your barangay.

Check-ups

Go to your barangay health station or the Municipal Health Office. First-time patients are usually given a treatment record. Bring a valid ID. Bring the child's ECCD card or the mother's prenatal record if you already have one.

Medicines

Bring the prescription or the referral slip. Ask the health station whether the medicine is in stock. This page does not name partner pharmacies or coverage caps for Ocampo.

Vaccines

Childhood vaccines under the Department of Health Expanded Program on Immunization are provided through barangay health stations. The national schedule includes BCG, hepatitis B, pentavalent, polio, pneumococcal, and MMR. The station sets the immunization day. Bring the ECCD card, or ask the staff to issue one.

Pregnant women can ask for tetanus toxoid and prenatal supplements during prenatal visits.

For an animal bite, go to the health station the same day and ask where anti-rabies vaccine is given. Do not wait for a schedule posted on this portal.

Rural health unit, pharmacy, and lying-in

The Ocampo Rural Health Unit, the LGU pharmacy, and the lying-in facility are in Brgy. Poblacion West, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419.

The 10-digit codes used elsewhere on this site for the same places are 0501725016 (Poblacion West) and 0501725000 (the municipality). This table keeps the codes as the health registry prints them.

Sources: Department of Health National Health Facility Registry, and PhilGEPS notice GDS112024174 (12 November 2024).

Where to go

Your barangay health station
Ocampo Rural Health Unit, Brgy. Poblacion West, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
LGU Facebook page for announcements
Department of Health for the national immunization schedule

The header RHU number, confirmed with the LGU, is 9122516900. The Municipal Health Office number in the LGU directory is 0927-772-8320.

The RHU OCAMPO page exists. Its listed mobile matches the header number.

title: Access Maternal Care and Child Immunization — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: - [Department of Health — Expanded Program on Immunization](https://doh.gov.ph/)
content:
Access Maternal Care and Child Immunization — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Prenatal care and routine childhood immunization in Ocampo are delivered through barangay health stations and the Municipal Health Office. Clinic days are set locally and are not copied here.

Maternal care

Ask your barangay health station for:

Prenatal check-ups
Family planning counseling
Tetanus toxoid and prenatal supplements, when the program has supply

Bring any previous prenatal card and a valid ID. The staff will open a record if you are a new patient.

Child immunization

Routine childhood vaccines are part of the Department of Health Expanded Program on Immunization. Doses follow the child's age, not a single weekday published for every town. Bring the ECCD card. The health worker can issue one on the first visit and will write the return date for the next dose.

How to avail

1. Go to the barangay health station that covers your household.
2. Register or update the prenatal record or the child's ECCD card.
3. Receive the service that is scheduled that day.
4. Keep the return date the midwife or nurse gives you.

The lying-in facility is part of the Ocampo Rural Health Unit in Brgy. Poblacion West, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419 (DOH facility code DOH000000000001517, short code 1517). Facility-based delivery and mother's classes, if the municipality is running them, are announced by the health station or the LGU Facebook page. Clinic days and a phone number are not listed here.

Source: Department of Health National Health Facility Registry, and PhilGEPS notice GDS112024174 (12 November 2024). See the check-ups guide for the registry codes.

References

Department of Health — Expanded Program on Immunization
Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419

content:
Go to the Local Hospital for Treatment or Confinement — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

This portal does not yet name a municipal hospital, its bed count, or a phone number for Ocampo. The Ocampo Rural Health Unit in Brgy. Poblacion West includes a lying-in facility (DOH facility code DOH000000000001517). That record is not a hospital bed count. For emergencies, go to the nearest emergency room. For a planned admission, ask the Municipal Health Office where residents are referred.

Source: Department of Health National Health Facility Registry, and PhilGEPS notice GDS112024174 (12 November 2024).

Emergency

1. Go to the emergency room. Do not wait for an appointment.
2. Staff will triage and take initial orders.
3. If you are admitted, sign the consent, then submit any ID, PhilHealth papers, or HMO letter you have. Missing papers can usually be followed up by a relative.

Planned confinement

1. Get the admitting order from the physician.
2. Bring a valid ID, PhilHealth ID and Member Data Record, and the HMO or company guarantee letter if you have one.
3. Complete admission and billing before you go to the room.

What to bring

A photo ID
PhilHealth ID and Member Data Record, or proof that you are a dependent
The doctor's referral, for a planned admission
Personal items for a stay

PhilHealth benefits and No Balance Billing depend on membership category and on whether the facility is a government hospital accredited for that package. Confirm both at the billing desk. This page does not post room rates.

Where to ask before a non-urgent visit

Municipal Health Office, Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
Your barangay health station
LGU Facebook page

No hospital trunk line is published here.

A post on the BFP R5 Ocampo page says a drill was held at Ocampo District Hospital. That name is the post's. This page still does not treat it as a confirmed hospital record.

title: Join Health Programs — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: - Barangay health station
content:
Join Health Programs — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Nutrition services, dengue control, and tuberculosis treatment reach residents through the barangay health station and the Municipal Health Office. These follow Department of Health programs. Local activity dates are announced by the station or the LGU Facebook page, not fixed on this page.

Nutrition

Barangay nutrition scholars and the health station can tell you whether supplementary feeding or growth monitoring is open for your child. Nutrition Month is July nationwide. Ask the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office if a feeding list is being prepared in your barangay.

Dengue

The Department of Health 4S strategy is Search and destroy breeding sites, Seek early consultation, Self-protection, and Support spraying only when health staff schedule it. Join barangay clean-ups when the barangay calls them. You do not need to register.

Tuberculosis

The National Tuberculosis Program provides screening and directly observed treatment through DOTS facilities. If a cough lasts two weeks or more, or there is weight loss or night sweats, go to the barangay health station and ask to be assessed. Medicines under the program are not something you buy from a list on this portal. The station will say where treatment is supervised.

What to bring

A valid ID and any barangay health record you already have.

Where to go

Barangay health station
Municipal Health Office, Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
Department of Health

title: Enroll Children in Daycare or Preschool — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: - Your barangay hall and daycare worker
content:
Enroll Children in Daycare or Preschool — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Daycare in Ocampo is handled by the barangay and the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office. Kindergarten is a Department of Education program in public elementary schools. Enrollment dates are announced by the barangay or the school. They are not listed here.

Daycare

Daycare is for young children, commonly ages 3 to 4, before kindergarten. Ask your barangay hall which center serves your sitio and whether a slot is still open.

Typical papers:

Birth certificate (PSA or local civil registrar)
Barangay certificate or proof that the child lives in the barangay
ID photo, if the center asks for one
The enrollment form from the center

Ask the center whether the program is free or whether parents share the cost of materials. Do not rely on a fee published for another city.

Kindergarten

DepEd kindergarten is for children who are five years old by the opening of the school year. Enroll at the public elementary school that covers your address during early registration or the regular enrollment period.

Typical papers:

PSA birth certificate
Barangay certificate
ID photo
The school's registration form

Public kindergarten does not charge tuition.

Where to confirm

Your barangay hall and daycare worker
Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office, Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
The public elementary school for your address
Schools Division of Camarines Sur, through the school registrar
LGU Facebook page

content:
Apply for Local Scholarships — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

The Municipality of Ocampo has not published a scholarship call, a list of partner schools, or a coverage amount on this portal. When the municipality or the district representative opens slots, the notice should come from the LGU Facebook page or the Municipal Hall.

Unverified: A Scribd copy of Barangay Hanawan Ordinance No. 001, s. 2026, is titled as the Sangguniang Kabataan Project ACCESS educational assistance measure. Scribd is not an official posting. This page does not treat the program as open, and it does not list a benefit amount or a deadline.

Residents can still apply to national programs on their own.

National programs to check

Coverage and deadlines change every cycle. Read the current call. Do not use an old announcement from another city.

Papers that are often required

Barangay certificate of residency in Ocampo
PSA birth certificate
Report card or grades
Certificate of good moral character
Proof of family income, or a certificate of indigency if the program asks for it
Photos and a school ID or proof of admission

How to apply

1. Choose a program that is actually open.
2. Save the eligibility rules and the deadline.
3. Request barangay and school certificates early.
4. File only through the link or window named in that call.
5. If you are accepted, keep the grade requirement and renew each term.

Where to watch

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
LGU Facebook page
Your school's scholarship desk

title: Access Educational Support from the LGU — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: - Your public school
content:
Access Educational Support from the LGU — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Ocampo has not published a current list of school-supply distributions, a municipal e-library, or an open student-employment call on this portal. Use the offices below to ask what is open this school year.

School supplies and the Special Education Fund

The Special Education Fund is a local fund for public basic education. Whether the municipality is distributing supplies this year is decided by the local school board and the schools. Ask your public school for the schedule. This page does not link to another city's memo.

Student employment (SPES)

The Special Program for the Employment of Students is a Department of Labor and Employment program for low-income students and out-of-school youth, usually ages 15 to 30. A municipality implements it through its Public Employment Service Office when a slot is opened. Follow DOLE Region V and the LGU Facebook page for a call. Do not send documents to a page that is not the municipality or DOLE.

Scholarships

See the scholarships guide for national programs. A municipal scholarship exists only when the municipality posts a call.

Cash or education assistance

The Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation program is run by the Department of Social Welfare and Development, often with the local social welfare office for the venue and the list. Announcements for Camarines Sur come from DSWD Field Office V and the municipality. Bring the ID and enrollment proof named in that announcement.

Papers to keep ready

PSA birth certificate
Barangay certificate
School ID and grades or a certificate of enrollment
ID photos

Youth office

The Local Youth Development Office page calls itself the municipal youth office and names Ms. Karen A. Benosa as LYDO-Designate. That name is not in the LGU office directory, so this page does not add a phone number for the office.

A post on that page dated 23 February 2026 said nine of 25 barangay Sangguniang Kabataan councils had submitted 2025 monitoring reports. Another post that day said twelve of 25 had complied with a financial-disclosure count it dated 20 February 2025. Those figures are the page's own.

Where to ask

Your public school
Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office and the mayor's office, Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
LGU Facebook page
DOLE for SPES rules
DSWD for assistance programs

content:
Supplementary Activities for Schools — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Clubs, contests, and scouting in Ocampo start at the school. Division-wide events are announced by the Schools Division of Camarines Sur through the school, not by a city hall in another province. This page does not list a municipal library schedule.

Schools and training sites named in public registries

These entries are registry listings. This page does not add tuition, a course list, or a local phone.

Where to look

1. The school's bulletin or official social media page.
2. The adviser for the club or the MAPEH, science, or TLE department.
3. DepEd orders that apply in every division, linked below.

Organizations recognized in public schools

Schools also field science, arts, ICT, and sports groups. Tryouts are posted by the school.

Alternative learning

The Alternative Learning System is for learners who are out of school or need a flexible schedule. Ask the nearest public school who the ALS teacher is for Ocampo.

How to join

1. Check the school's club fair or adviser list.
2. Bring a school ID and a parent consent form if the adviser requires one.
3. Note the meeting time and any safety rules.
4. Ask whether the activity charges a fee. Many do not.

For parents

Ask who supervises the activity, when it ends, and how learners get home. Keep academics and activities on a weekly schedule the learner can sustain.

title: Apply for Barangay Clearance and the Mayor's Business Permit — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: No municipal hotline or office email is published on this portal.
content:
Apply for Barangay Clearance and the Mayor's Business Permit — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Businesses in the Municipality of Ocampo, Camarines Sur need a barangay clearance and a mayor's business permit before they operate. National registration (DTI, SEC, or CDA, then BIR) is separate from the municipal permit.

The municipality has not published its permit checklist, fees, or an online portal on this page. Confirm the current list at the Business Permits and Licensing Office in the Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419, or on the LGU Facebook page.

Public scrape, stated by the LGU. That page announced the launching of the DTI Negosyo Center on 27 October 2026 at the New Public Market Building, Poblacion West. The post does not list the center's services or fees.

1. Register the business name

Use the registry that matches the business:

Sole proprietor: DTI Business Name Registration
Partnership or corporation: SEC eSPARC
Cooperative: Cooperative Development Authority

2. Get a barangay clearance

Go to the barangay hall where the business is located.

Typical documents:

Valid ID of the owner or authorized representative
Proof of address (lease or proof of ownership)
DTI, SEC, or CDA registration

The barangay sets its own form and fee. This page does not list them.

3. Apply for the mayor's business permit

File at the municipal Business Permits and Licensing Office. Inspections can include zoning, sanitary, and Bureau of Fire Protection checks. There is no verified Ocampo online business-permit portal to link here.

Bring:

Barangay clearance for the business
DTI, SEC, or CDA certificate
Occupancy permit, or a lease if you rent
Community Tax Certificate, if the office asks for one
Valid ID

4. Register with the BIR

File at the Revenue District Office that covers Ocampo.

New corporations and partnerships often use BIR Form 1903
Sole proprietors use the form the RDO assigns for their case
After registration, secure authority to print receipts or enroll in e-invoicing, and register the books of accounts

Forms and deadlines are on bir.gov.ph.

5. Register as an employer, if you hire people

Enroll with SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.

Checklist

[ ] DTI, SEC, or CDA registration
[ ] Barangay clearance
[ ] Lease or occupancy documents
[ ] Municipal business-permit form and Community Tax Certificate
[ ] BIR registration, receipts, and books
[ ] SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG, if you have employees

Where to confirm

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
ocampo.camarinessur.gov.ph
LGU Facebook page

No municipal hotline or office email is published on this portal.

title: Renew Permits and Pay Local Business Taxes — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419. Updates are also posted on the [LGU Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/101706771551898). No hotline is listed here. content:
Renew Permits and Pay Local Business Taxes — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Renew the mayor's business permit and pay local business taxes with the Municipality of Ocampo. Rates and extra fees come from the municipal revenue code. This page does not restate those amounts.

Who must renew

Every business operating in Ocampo, including sole proprietors, partnerships, corporations, cooperatives, and professionals with a local office. Renew the main office and each branch.

When to renew

The Local Government Code sets the annual business-tax period in the first twenty days of January. Quarterly payers usually settle the next quarters on or before the twentieth of April, July, and October. Late payment can add a surcharge and interest, up to the ceilings in the Code, as applied by the municipal ordinance.

Prepare documents in December so you can file in the first week of January.

What to bring

Last year's mayor's permit and official receipts
DTI, SEC, or CDA registration
BIR Certificate of Registration (Form 2303)
Lease, tax declaration, or occupancy permit
Sworn declaration of gross sales or receipts for the previous year
Barangay clearance, sanitary permit, and Fire Safety Inspection Certificate when the office routes you for them
Valid ID, and a special power of attorney or board resolution if you are not the owner

Clearances depend on the business. Bring the previous permits so the evaluator can see what was required last year.

Walk-in steps

1. Go to the Business Permits and Licensing Office at the Municipal Hall during the renewal period.
2. Fill out the renewal form and the sworn declaration of gross sales. Report changes in name, activity, area, machinery, employees, or address.
3. Complete any routing to the barangay, sanitary office, zoning, environment office, or the Bureau of Fire Protection.
4. The office assesses local business tax and regulatory fees. Ask whether annual or quarterly payment is allowed for your business.
5. Pay at the municipal treasurer and keep the official receipt.
6. Claim the new permit and post it at the place of business.

Ocampo has not published an online renewal portal on this page. Ask the licensing office at the start of January whether pre-filing is open.

How dues are computed

Local business tax is based on the previous year's gross sales or receipts and on the category in the local tax ordinance. Other charges can include sanitary, garbage, signage, and fire-related fees. This portal does not publish the brackets.

If something changed

Report a new address, name, owner, activity, floor area, or closure. File a retirement if the business stops, settle delinquencies, and surrender the old permit so taxes do not keep accruing.

Checklist

[ ] Last year's permit and receipts
[ ] DTI, SEC, or CDA papers and BIR Form 2303
[ ] Lease, occupancy, or tax declaration
[ ] Sworn gross sales or financial statements
[ ] Barangay clearance and other routed clearances
[ ] ID or authorization for the representative
[ ] Payment for the assessed tax and fees

Where to confirm

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419. Updates are also posted on the LGU Facebook page. No hotline is listed here. Municipal revenue-code rates and Citizen's Charter fees stay blank until the ordinance or charter is read from a public source.

Rent Stalls in Public Markets — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Stall rental in a public market is handled by the Municipality of Ocampo. This portal does not yet have the market's stall map, rental rates, or application form.

Ask the municipal treasurer or the market office at the Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419, and check announcements on the LGU Facebook page.

When you inquire, ask for:

Who may apply, and whether residents are prioritized
The current monthly rate and any deposit
The lease length and the rules on transferring a stall
Required IDs, barangay clearance, and a mayor's permit if you will sell from the stall

Do not pay a reservation fee to anyone who cannot issue an official receipt from the municipality.

title: Join Trade Fairs, Business Expos, or Tourism Promotions — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: No tourism-office phone number or email has been verified for this page.
content:
Join Trade Fairs, Business Expos, or Tourism Promotions — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Ocampo businesses can join fairs and promotions run by the municipality, the barangay, the provincial government, or national agencies. This page does not list a current Ocampo event calendar. Watch the LGU Facebook page and ask the mayor's office or the business permits office when a call opens.

The Ocampo Tourism, Culture and the Arts Office page lists its place as Market Site, Poblacion West, Governor Jose T. Fuentebella National Highway, Ocampo 4419. The same listing shows Monday–Thursday, 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. It does not show Friday hours or a phone number. Public scrape. The office directory does not confirm this address or these hours.

Who usually joins

Micro, small, and medium enterprises
Cooperatives and livelihood associations
Tourism and food enterprises, when the event asks for them
Makers of local products, including OTOP-style goods

Organizers decide eligibility. Registration with DTI, SEC, or CDA and a current mayor's permit are the usual starting point.

How to apply when a call is open

1. Prepare DTI, SEC, or CDA registration, BIR Form 2303, and the current mayor's permit.
2. Add product compliance when it applies, such as an FDA license for processed food.
3. Submit the organizer's form with a product list, photos, and booth needs.
4. Pay a booth fee only if the written guidelines say there is one. Do not assume a fee from another town applies in Ocampo.
5. Follow ingress, electrical, fire, and waste rules on the event days.

What to budget for

Treat these as your own planning items, not as municipal fees:

Booth fee, if the organizer charges one
Tarpaulin, labels, and price cards
Samples, staff meals, and transport
A small contingency

After the event

Write down leads, orders, and what sold. Follow up within a few days. Keep receipts and the event guidelines with your business records.

Sample inquiry

> Subject: Booth inquiry for [event name]
>
> Hello. We are an Ocampo, Camarines Sur business offering [product]. We would like to join [event] on [date]. Attached are our registration, product list, and photos. Thank you.

Where to ask

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
Official website
LGU Facebook page

No tourism-office phone number or email has been verified for this page.

content:
Apply for Senior Citizen, Solo Parent, or PWD Assistance — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Senior citizen, solo parent, and person-with-disability IDs are issued through municipal offices in Ocampo. The municipality has not published a local cash amount, a fee, or its own document checklist on this portal. Ask the office below which papers it wants this month.

Phone numbers and emails for these offices are on the contact directory. They come from the LGU office directory and are not repeated here.

Senior citizen ID

The Office of the Senior Citizens (OSCA) is headed by Salvacion T. Evora. The Expanded Senior Citizens Act (Republic Act 9994) covers Filipino residents who are 60 or older. OSCA is the office that issues the senior citizen ID. National discounts and privileges are in that law. This page does not add a local cash grant.

The municipal complex study places the Senior Citizen's Office in the town complex. It does not give a room number.

Solo parent ID

The Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) is headed by Eleanor C. Mangubat. The Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act (Republic Act 11861) is the national law for the solo parent ID. Ask MSWDO whether Ocampo is issuing IDs and what proof of status it requires. A local subsidy amount is not published here.

Person with disability ID

The Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO) is headed by Edwin G. Vales. The Magna Carta for Disabled Persons (Republic Act 7277) and Republic Act 10754 set the national ID and discount rules. Ask PDAO which medical certificate it accepts. This page does not list a local benefit amount.

Where to ask

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
Your barangay hall, if the office asks for a barangay certificate
LGU Facebook page
Contact directory for the phone and email

No fee, schedule, or cash amount is listed here.

Sources

LGU Ocampo official directory — office heads for OSCA, MSWDO, and PDAO. The same directory is transcribed on the contact page.
Republic Act 9994 — senior citizen ID and national privileges
Republic Act 11861 — solo parent ID
Republic Act 7277 and Republic Act 10754 — PWD ID and national discounts
Ocampo Municipal Complex Architectural Redevelopment Study — Senior Citizen's Office is in the municipal complex

title: Receive Relief Goods or Cash Aid during Disasters — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: - LGU Ocampo official directory — MSWDO and MDRRMO heads. Phone and email stay on the contact page.
content:
Receive Relief Goods or Cash Aid during Disasters — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Relief goods and cash aid in Ocampo are released through the barangay and the municipal offices below. This page does not list a pack, a peso amount, a payout date, or an evacuation center. Those change with each event, and the municipality has not published a standing schedule here.

Cash aid that is not disaster relief is posted on Mswd Ocampo. A 19 November 2026 post there announced an Uplift Program payout on 21 November 2026 at the Ocampo Cultural and Sports Complex in Poblacion West. Details are on the family and community welfare page.

For a life-threatening emergency, call 911. The header MDRRMO number, confirmed with the LGU, is 9475714857. The office directory lists 0915-919-9832 for that office on the contact directory.

Where to go first

1. Go to your barangay hall, or send one household member if travel is unsafe. Give your full name, address, and how many people are in the house.
2. Ask whether the barangay is preparing a list for the municipal social welfare office, or whether a distribution is already set.
3. Follow the announcement on the LGU Facebook page. A post from another town is not an Ocampo distribution.

Municipal offices

The Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) is headed by Eleanor C. Mangubat. Residents ask this office about family lists and about Department of Social Welfare and Development assistance that uses the municipal office as the venue.

The Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) is headed by Julius B. Celino. The municipal complex study places that office in Brgy. Hibago. It does not give a street address or a room number.

National aid, not a local rate

The Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act (Republic Act 10121) is the national framework for local disaster offices. Cash aid such as Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation is a Department of Social Welfare and Development program. Field Office V and the municipality announce when a payout is open. This page does not copy an amount from another city.

Sources

LGU Ocampo official directory — MSWDO and MDRRMO heads. Phone and email stay on the contact page.
Ocampo Municipal Complex Architectural Redevelopment Study — MDRRMO is in Brgy. Hibago.
Republic Act 10121 — national disaster law.
Department of Social Welfare and Development — national assistance programs, including crisis aid.
LGU Facebook page — public announcements from the municipality.

content:
Get Family and Community Welfare Support — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Barangay-level community projects and Indigenous Peoples communities are recorded in the sources below. This page does not list a cash amount, a schedule, or a hotline.

Kalahi CIDSS

The International Journal of Research and Innovation in Social Science (June 2026) describes barangay-level Kalahi CIDSS implementation in Ocampo through:

Barangay Representative Teams (BRTs)
Barangay Sub-Project Management Committees (BSPMCs)
Community bids and awards committees

The article is the source for those bodies. It is not used here to name a project, a barangay, or a cost. The municipal complex study also places a Kalahi CIDSS office in the town complex. That is an office location, not a project list.

Indigenous Peoples communities

The NCIP 2022 Annual Accomplishment Report documents Indigenous Peoples communities under a Certificate of Ancestral Domain Title in the municipality. The community names, the CADT number, and the boundary are not in the note used for this page, so they stay blank.

The municipal complex study lists an Office of the Indigenous People in the town complex. That listing is not the CADT record.

Announcement on the MSWDO page

The page Mswd Ocampo describes itself as the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office account. On 19 November 2026 it announced an Uplift Program payout for the 3rd and 4th tranches:

Date: 21 November 2026
Time: 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Place: Ocampo Cultural and Sports Complex, Poblacion West

The post tells qualified beneficiaries to bring a valid national ID, three photocopies with three specimen signatures on each copy, and an active GCash number. It says active 4Ps beneficiaries do not need to attend. This is that post. It is not a standing schedule, and this page does not add a peso amount.

description: No environment-office phone number is listed here. Barangay collection days stay blank until the municipality publishes them.
content:
Check Garbage Collection Schedules and Request Pickup — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

The Municipality of Ocampo collects household waste with the barangays. The collection day for each barangay is not published on this page. Ask the barangay hall, and follow announcements on the LGU Facebook page.

Regular collection

Segregate waste before it goes out: biodegradable, recyclable, residual, and special or hazardous waste. Put the bin out only on the barangay's collection day. Open burning is prohibited under Republic Act 9003 and the Clean Air Act.

If a truck is delayed because of weather or a holiday, the barangay or the municipal environment office should announce the change. This portal does not keep that calendar.

Bulk or special pickup

Furniture, appliances, construction debris, and yard waste that does not fit the regular route need a separate request.

1. Go to the barangay hall and describe the waste, the volume, and the address.
2. Ask whether the barangay or the municipal environment office will schedule a truck.
3. Ask whether a fee applies. Do not assume a fee from another local government.

Hazardous waste and electronics should not go on the regular truck. Use the special-waste guide.

Businesses

Establishments must segregate waste. Industrial or bulky waste may need an accredited hauler. Keep receipts for inspections. The municipal environment office can say what Ocampo requires.

Where to ask

Your barangay hall
Municipal environment office, Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419
LGU Facebook page

No environment-office phone number is listed here. Barangay collection days stay blank until the municipality publishes them.

title: Proper Waste Segregation and Disposal — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419, or the [LGU Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/101706771551898).
content:
Proper Waste Segregation and Disposal — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Segregation in Ocampo follows Republic Act 9003, the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act. The municipal ordinance may add local rules and fines. Those peso amounts are not copied here.

Separate these

Rules that apply everywhere

Do not burn waste.
Do not put garbage out on a day the truck is not coming.
Construction debris is not household waste. Ask the barangay who may haul it.
Republic Act 9003 requires barangays to set up a materials recovery facility. Ask your barangay hall where theirs is, or where to bring recyclables if it is not yet operating.

Businesses

Keep separate bins for customers and staff. Keep hauling receipts if you hire a private collector. Food businesses can ask the barangay whether kitchen waste can go to a composting area.

Penalties

Illegal dumping and open burning can be penalized under RA 9003 and the municipal ordinance. Repeated violations can affect a business permit. Ask the municipal environment office for the schedule of fines instead of using another city's amounts.

Where to ask

Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419, or the LGU Facebook page.

How to request pickup

2. Ask whether they will send the request to the municipal environment office or whether a drop-off day is already set.
3. Keep items in a closed, labeled box. Do not break bulbs or take devices apart.
4. Put the box out only when the barangay tells you to, or bring it to the drop-off they name.

A junk shop may accept some electronics. Ask the municipal environment office which collectors they recognize. Do not treat an unverified buyer as the municipal program.

title: Report Illegal Dumping or Waste Violations — Ocampo, Camarines Sur
description: No environment hotline is published on this portal.
content:
Report Illegal Dumping or Waste Violations — Ocampo, Camarines Sur

Illegal dumping, open burning, and mixing hazardous waste with household trash violate Republic Act 9003. Report them to the barangay first, then to the municipal environment office if the problem continues.

What to report

Trash thrown in vacant lots, waterways, sidewalks, or open space
Burning of household waste, plastic, or tires
Businesses that mix waste or dump outside collection day
Batteries, chemicals, or medical waste left with regular garbage
A pile that has not been collected and is drawing pests

How to report

1. Go to the barangay hall or message the barangay's own page. Give the place, the date and time, the kind of waste, and a photo if you have one.
2. If the barangay cannot address it, go to the municipal environment office at the Municipal Hall, Ocampo, Camarines Sur 4419.
3. If the dumping is dangerous or involves a large truck, you can also tell the Philippine National Police station that covers Ocampo.

The LGU Facebook page is for announcements. A public comment is not a substitute for a report to the barangay.

After a report

The barangay or the municipal inspector visits the site. Penalties depend on the ordinance and on RA 9003. This page does not list peso fines. Photos, the exact location, and the time make the report easier to act on. You may leave a name and number if you want a follow-up.

No environment hotline is published on this portal.
